project.name: Cordit
project.tagline: Public stranger chat + voice with live observer mode, music sharing, and dynamic wallpaper glassmorphism
project.description: Cordit is a self-hosted, lightweight real-time communication platform combining the spontaneous discovery of Omegle/Chatroulette with Discord-like persistent voice channels and a unique spectator observer mode. Features include numeric anonymous Public IDs (#7368), bidirectional gender-compatible matching, real-time spectator suggestions, browser-to-browser music sharing, and an adaptive wallpaper-driven frosted glassmorphism design system.

core_philosophy.anonymity_with_accountability: Users are assigned clean numeric 4-to-6 digit Public IDs (e.g., #7368) to protect identity while retaining reputation, moderation trails, and ban capabilities.
core_philosophy.transparent_public_conversations: All stranger chat rooms are 100% public by design. Spectators can drop in as read-only observers, watch conversations unfold in real time, and submit helpful suggestions without breaking conversation flow.
core_philosophy.immersive_visual_harmony: UI surfaces are constructed with frosted translucent glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md/xl) that adapt colors, chat bubbles, waveform visualizers, and glowing accents to match the active desktop wallpaper.

system_architecture.topology: Micro-monolith with separated frontend and backend services backed by MongoDB and a dedicated LiveKit WebRTC Selective Forwarding Unit (SFU).

services.name: Frontend Application
services.role: Single Page Application with App Router, server-rendered landing, reactive client components, and audio/socket controllers.
services.technology: Next.js 16 (Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, Zustand

services.name: Backend API & Real-time Server
services.role: REST API for authentication, user profiles, room management, upload pipelines, and Socket.io server for matching, messaging, and suggestions.
services.technology: Node.js 20+, Express 4, TypeScript (tsx), Mongoose, Socket.io, LiveKit Server SDK, Winston, Zod

services.name: Voice & Media SFU
services.role: Selective Forwarding Unit managing low-latency WebRTC audio channels, participant tracks, and speaking volume indicators.

services.name: Primary Database
services.role: Document store for users, public IDs, rooms, chat messages, spectator suggestions, moderation reports, blocks, and invite tokens.
services.technology: MongoDB (Local or MongoDB Memory Server / Docker)

stranger_chat_and_matchmaking.summary: Instant peer matching based on mutual gender preferences and numeric Public IDs.
capabilities: Numeric Public IDs: 4-6 digit numeric handles (#7368) generated at registration.
Mutual Compatibility Filtering: Matches 'My Gender' (male, female, other) with 'Looking For' (male, female, any) bidirectionally.
Direct Public ID Connect: Enter a specific public ID to connect directly with an active user.
Queue Pool Management: Real-time pooling with timeout fallbacks and automatic reconnection handling.

public_conversations_and_observer_mode.summary: Any active conversation can be observed live by other community members.
capabilities: Unauthenticated or Peer Spectating: Observers join rooms in read-only mode without requiring host approval.
Live Observer Count: Real-time badges notify active chatters how many spectators are watching.
Spectator Suggestions: Observers can submit conversation starters and icebreakers.
Participant Privacy Controls: Chat participants can toggle observer advice visibility on or off at will.
Strict Server-side Enforcement: Observers are prevented at the WebSocket handler level from sending direct chat messages.

voice_channels_and_spatial_audio.summary: Low-latency WebRTC voice communication powered by LiveKit SFU.
capabilities: Live Voice Rooms: Embedded voice channels inside stranger chats or standalone public channels.
Dynamic Waveform Visualizer: Animated audio spectrum bars that sync with voice activity.
Per-User Volume Controls: Independent volume sliders for each participant in the call.
Mute & Deafen: Hardware and software mic toggle with local stream pausing.

browser_tab_music_sharing.summary: Desktop browser audio capture for shared listening sessions.
capabilities: Zero-transcode Streaming: Leverages navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ audio: true }) to stream audio directly.
Universal Compatibility: Streams Spotify, YouTube, Soundcloud, or any open browser tab.
Synchronized Audio Track: Streams as an auxiliary audio track in the LiveKit room.

dynamic_wallpaper_glassmorphism_theming.summary: Contextual UI adaptation based on 8 curated desktop artworks.

curated_wallpapers.title: Starlit Valley Beneath the Golden Tree

aesthetic_features: Ultra-Clear Frosted Glass: backdrop-blur-md/2xl with 12%-35% transparency allows background artwork to show through cleanly.
Color Token Adaptation: Accent borders, message bubbles, brand tags, and waveform hues automatically adjust when switching wallpapers.
Custom Auth Portal: Glowing violet glass card with interactive password visibility toggle, matching the moonlit cherry blossom landscape.

moderation_and_safety.summary: Multi-tier defense to keep public stranger chats civil and safe.
capabilities: One-Click User Blocking: Blocks target user by Public ID, permanently eliminating future matches.
Incident Reporting: Generates an immutable snapshot containing recent messages, room ID, reporter, and suspect ID.
Admin Moderation Console: Dedicated /admin portal for inspecting reported chat contexts, suspending accounts, and executing permanent bans.

auth_and_user.desc: Register account, assign gender preferences & generate publicId
Authenticate by username or publicId, issue JWT token
Fetch authenticated user profile and block list
Lookup active user by numeric publicId

rooms_and_messages.desc: List public rooms and active stranger sessions
Generate LiveKit WebRTC access token for voice channel
Retrieve historical messages for a room

moderation_and_admin.desc: File a report with incident snapshot
Admin review queue of reported users
Suspend or ban a user account

directory_structure.components/: UI modules (MasterFeedTile, LeftNavigation, RightSidebar, VoiceChat, MatchingModal, WallpaperModal, etc.)
directory_structure.lib/: State store (Zustand), API client (Axios), Socket hooks (useSocket), Theme registry (themeRegistry.ts, ThemeContext.tsx)
